2026So Far: The Streak Is Dead, and the Quiet Man Found the Waiver WireIn progress · 4 weeks in · Birdgangflyeagles 7-1, dahlilama 6-2, elysianbeer 6-2

Four weeks in, the longest winning streak in league history ended by less than two points, the league leader took his first head-to-head loss, and a new name sits atop the points table. The evidence so far.

7-1Birdgangflyeagles, 4-0 head-to-head
1.82points that ended juleon8's 11-game streak
152.58elysianbeer's Week 4, top score of the week
79transactions so far

Eleven and done

juleon8's league-record head-to-head winning streak, which started in Week 7 of 2025, ended at 11 straight. Birdgangflyeagles beat him 96.78–94.96, a 1.82-point margin. Both scores were below the week's median, so both took the median loss too. juleon8 is 3-5. The record stays in the book; the jury just stopped adding to it.

The quiet man made a move. Two, actually.

After three weeks without a single transaction, Birdgangflyeagles made two waiver claims. He's still 4-0 head-to-head, now 7-1 overall, and still has the fewest points against in the league (336). His only loss of the year is to the league median. Last year he went 3-11. The deliberations continue.

dahlilama's first real loss

Rookie kevinnguu picked up his first head-to-head win, 135.92–125.40, and he did it against the futures favorite. dahlilama's 125.40 was above the median, so he still banked half the week and sits at 6-2, still the favorite at +200. He's no longer the league's points leader, though.

Goldminers1 takes the points crown

One week after his 175.08, Goldminers1 beat MayockJr 144.32–73.28 and now leads the league with 542 points, 11 ahead of dahlilama. He's won two straight head-to-head and is 5-3. Yes, this is the same juror who owns the record for weekly low scores (10). People change.

elysianbeer, quietly 6-2

elysianbeer posted the week's top score, 152.58, in a 73.26-point win over Bjspjs4. That's three straight head-to-head wins and a 6-2 record, tied with dahlilama for second. Meanwhile Bjspjs4 has dropped two straight after his 2-0 start and has given up 492 points, third-most in the league.

Also in the file

  • giJ03 beat Sleon1000 130.14–76.98 for his second straight win and is back to 4-4.
  • Sleon1000, the #1 seed the last two years, is 0-4 head-to-head and 2-6, with the most points against in the league (522).
  • rbanuelos3 edged showmeyourtd23 98.22–94.82 to get to 5-3. showmeyourtd23 is 0-4 head-to-head and 1-7.
  • MayockJr had the week's low score (73.28) and leads the league in moves with 20. No new trades since Week 2.

cases.dahlilama: 2023 champ, 2025 runner-up and Points King, 4-1 all-time in the playoffs. 6-2, and second in the league in points.
cases.rbanuelos3: Owns the season points record (1,858) and the highest score ever (180.24). Two playoff trips, no ring, and 5-3 after his 8-game head-to-head win streak ended in Week 3.
cases.Birdgangflyeagles: 7-1 and 4-0 head-to-head, with the league's fewest points against. Finally made his first two moves of the year. Has been a 1 seed and a last-place team. No middle gear.
cases.elysianbeer: Dropped 152.58 in Week 4 and has won three straight. Still paying off last October's trade.
cases.Sleon1000: Best all-time record (26-16) and two straight #1 seeds, but 0-2 in the playoffs and 2-6 this year.
cases.juleon8: Owns the league-record 11-game head-to-head win streak, snapped by 1.82 points in Week 4. Went from 1-5 to the 3 seed last year.
cases.Goldminers1: Four seasons, no playoff trips yet, and a league-record 10 weekly low scores. Also leads the league in points after a 175.08 and a 144.32.
cases.kevinnguu: Rookie. 122.86 in his debut, and his first head-to-head win came against the futures favorite.
cases.giJ03: Rookie, back to 4-4 after two straight wins, two weeks removed from a 55.74. The field.
cases.MayockJr: The league's busiest manager. 61 moves last year turned a 7-7 team into a third-place finish.
cases.Bjspjs4: 4-4 with three trades already, drafting from slot 8, the slot that's won all three titles. The 17-25 career mark is why the number's this long.
cases.showmeyourtd23: Reached the first title game without making a trade. Hasn't made the playoffs since.
